verdict.why: Wrangler now prompts to update installed Cloudflare agent skills after eligible commands, suppressible via an env var.

draft.detail: Wrangler now offers to update Cloudflare skills after eligible commands complete; the environment variable can also suppress prompts.

source.quote: Wrangler now offers to update them after eligible commands complete.
The `WRANGLER_NO_SKILLS_UPDATE_PROMPTS=true` environment variable can also be used to suppress prompts.
